signature_object.note: this sha256+bytes is what the user signs; any edit needs a new signature

option: B (per-frame signed criteria + cross-frame change visibility assertion)

frames.name: frame-000
frames.note: equals base frame; shares the signed single-frame criteria

pose_step.mechanism: add k*dz to body_pos.z of flex-anchor0/1/2 in the model layer (reference: pinned mjwarp before put_model; product: in-memory model arrays before context creation); no physics stepping, no time integration

per_frame_criteria.determinism: two runs identical sha256 per frame per camera

cross_frame_criteria.threshold_derivation: 0.5% x 76,800 px = 384 px; frozen, never adjusted on site
cross_frame_criteria.measurement_side: reference frames (avoids circularity); product must equal reference bit-level per frame

degenerate_protection.in_384_to_576: insufficient margin -> capture fails, stop and report to user; thresholds unchanged
degenerate_protection.changing_step_parameters: requires a new spec sha and a new user signature; the 0.5% threshold itself never changes

allowlist.new_frames: bit-first, no inheritance; a recurring same-pixel difference must be reported to the user instead of extending the allowance

failure_conditions: any frame/camera outside the per-frame criteria
cam2 adjacent-frame depth or seg changed pixels < 384
reference inter-frame change < 384 (non-discriminating) or in [384,576) (insufficient margin)
capture determinism failure (two captures not bit-identical)
any undeclared tolerance widening (including allowlist extension)
fail_stop: any failure stops the round; no retry, no relaxation, no on-site threshold change

env.recipe: use_fast_math=false, other parameters identical to reference/base/capture.json
env.gpu: same device as base reference (RTX 4070 Ti SUPER / driver 596.36 / SM89)

capture_plan.script_extension: scripts/authoring/capture_render_flex.py gains a frame loop (e.g. --frames 3 --frame-dz 0.1): apply anchor body_pos.z offset per frame, put_model, forward, render; single-frame path unchanged byte-for-byte
capture_plan.determinism: capture twice, per-frame file sha256 identical, otherwise capture fails

implementation_requirements: new test entity (e.g. render_flex_multiframe) reading the three frames: per-frame criteria then cam2 cross-frame criteria then two-run sha
product-side pose injection: in-memory body_pos.z offset for the three anchor bodies before context creation (fixture files untouched)
window material: new entity invalidates the current guard set (about 16 entries); freeze -Attempt re-freeze with new exe + three frame inputs
criterion implementation needs a read-only QA review (pixel-count direction, threshold derivation, allowlist boundary, degenerate protection)

signature_list.item: authoring exception pre-approval for the capture window (authoring-only util<60) if normal util<40 is not met

prerequisites: capture script frame loop implemented (implementation card verified)
QA read-only review of the script
pre-window 5-minute three-point baseline and strict floor
material posted to the dev group
capture evidence verified (3 frames + two-capture bit identity + changed pixels >= 576)
criteria implemented in the test (implementation card verified)
window material frozen (guards with new exe + 3 frame inputs)

risks: pose-change magnitude is camera-geometry dependent; if cam2 change < 576 the capture stops and reports (no step increase, no threshold change)
three frames prove two pose steps only; no continuous animation coverage claim
pose injection is authored (model-layer anchor offset), not physics evolution; the criterion tests render correctness vs pose, not physics/animation
artifact size about 14.2 MB and grows linearly with frame count
the new entity invalidates the current guard set until re-frozen
non_claims: no multi-frame coverage claim beyond the three authored frames
not a basis for external release
no capture, no window, no fixtures or product-code change in this card
